info.title: Flock Energy — Urja Meter Ops API Service
info.description: A clean, robust, well-documented programmatic REST API service and local index built over the legacy Urja Meter Ops utility portal. Features normalized meter schemas, reconstructed electrical network hierarchies, spatial proximity search, and time-series energy consumption analytics.

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive smart meter detail including normalized nameplate and full electrical network hierarchy.
Retrieve normalized nameplate technical specifications, harmonized across legacy and v2 meter models.

schema.title: Response Get Meter Nameplate Api V1 Meters  Meter Id  Nameplate Get

get.description: Retrieve time-series consumption readings (active kWh, apparent kVAh, and R-phase voltage) with optional date window filtering ('from_date' and 'to_date').
Retrieve aggregated consumption KPIs: net kWh delta, estimated power factor, and voltage quality stats.
Retrieve all distribution transformers in the utility network with rated capacity, parent feeder, and connected meter counts.

schema.title: Response List Transformers Api V1 Transformers Get

get.description: Retrieve distribution transformer detail along with the list of smart meters connected to it.
Retrieve the complete reconstructed electrical distribution hierarchy (Zone › Circle › Division › Subdivision › Substation › Feeder › DT) with subordinate meter counts.

get.description: Audit report detailing legacy data inconsistencies discovered in the Urja portal (aliased names like DT-007, blank codes, multi-parent feeder mappings) and the reconciliation strategy applied.
